voiceAnalyses

Class VoiceDistance

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
      • java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>
        • voiceAnalyses.VoiceDistance
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable, java.util.Map<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>, java.util.NavigableMap<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>, java.util.SortedMap<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>

    public class VoiceDistance
extends java.util.TreeMap<java.lang.Double,PitchInterval>
    This class represents the sequence of intervals between two musical voices. The format of the TreeMap entries is (date, PitchInterval), so it will later be possible to analyze the sequence and the timings.
